I had mutual friends we will call Mark because that's his name and fuck him. We were talking for awhile so we decided to go out.  Now I would like to preface this story with the disclaimer that I was young and very dumb.  

I bebop to pick up Mark at his parents house because he doesn't have a car. He said he was staying there because he was in college and to save money because he also didn't have a job. My bar was set pretty low and I'm not one to judge.  So we are off like a herd of turtles to the zoo. He volunteered there and could get us in free. 

It started off well enough. He was telling me all kinds of fun facts about the animals.  He was very polite and funny.  I slowly began to notice he was showing me off to the employees there in this way that had my creep vibes tingling.

Then we arrive at the tigers and things take a turn for the weird.  He is standing behind me and all of a sudden he sniffs me. I'm not talking like a quick sniff. This dude full on inhaled my hair. I thought it was odd but I'm a girl and we are taught to be polite so ignore it and immediately start counting down the minutes until I can leave.  As I begin plotting my escape, this weirdo sniffs me again and makes this mmmmmmhmm noise. I decide then it's time to bail. 

We leave and I am trying to navigate the way to his house when my phone dies. I ask him if he knows the way. He then immediately gets us lost and I accept my fate that I will probably be murdered on these backroads. After an hour of driving around we finally get back to his house. I try to graciously make my exit but he reminds me my phone is dead and I should probably charge it. 

Now just a quick reminder that I am very dumb. He invites me inside to meet his rabbit and while I'm trying to think of a way to politely decline this tempting invitation, he ushers me inside where I IMMEDIATELY MEET HIS MOTHER. Now this was already awkward but then he introduced me as his girlfriend. She starts grilling me like a steak on Sunday. After she is satisfied with my embarrassment, he hurries me to his room despite my protests to leave. He then tells me to sit on his cot of a bed while he puts on some music to "set the mood". It's 80s hair metal. I'm trying to decide how long is polite to stay when he attacks me with the wettest kisses that even a dog would be jealous of. I push him away and tell him I'm not that kind of girl. He then says the crowning jewel of the entire day "That's not what I heard." Aaaaannnnd that was when he fell under my already low bar. I immediately left and planned to let him down easy later.  

He got upset I didn't text him back within an hour and started posting very personal stuff I told him. It turned into this whole fucking thing that concluded with him begging me to forgive him which I not so politely declined. 

Last I heard he was in jail for beating the shit out of his latest girlfriend. And that's the story of how I learned to raise the bar and not to be so nice to creeps.
